random_split.protocol: random stratified 50/50 split over cycles (repair._stratified_split), inner CV ungrouped (groups=None), as in repair.py's leakage check

random_grouped_inner.protocol: random stratified 50/50 split over cycles, inner CV grouped by the setting of each fit cycle

stratified_cycles.protocol: StratifiedKFold(9, shuffle=True, random_state=seed) over the 94 collision cycles, inner CV ungrouped

leave_one_setting_out.protocol: leave-one-setting-out over the 9 collision settings, inner CV grouped by setting

collision.p_rule: fraction of the 84 labellings (identity included) with held-out accuracy >= observed

load_torque.draw_rng: numpy RandomState(seed), one permutation of the 32 setting labels per draw
load_torque.p_rule: (1 + draws with held-out accuracy >= observed) / (1 + draws)

note: Collision-group protocol check. Search, adoption rule and margins are repair.certify / repair.ADOPT_MARGIN unchanged. Outer random split = repair._stratified_split, leave-setting-out = repair._grouped_split, both over all 755 cycles and then restricted to the group, as repair.evaluate does.
